target.name: Delaware Enhanced Global Dividend and Income Fund

announcement.quote: The Board of Trustees of each of the Acquiring Funds, listed below, announces the proposed reorganization of several closed-end investment companies advised by one or more affiliates of Delaware Management Company into the respective Acquiring Funds (“Reorganizations”).

deals.notes: Special meetings were scheduled for 2022-11-09. No excerpted filing states an exchange listing for either fund or the outcome of the meeting.

target.name: Delaware Investments Dividend and Income Fund, Inc.

announcement.quote: The Board of Trustees of each of the Acquiring Funds, listed below, announces the proposed reorganization of several closed-end investment companies advised by one or more affiliates of Delaware Management Company into the respective Acquiring Funds (“Reorganizations”).

deals.notes: Each reorganization is stated not to be contingent on the other. No excerpted filing states an exchange listing or the outcome.

problems: The press release also lists IVH into ACP and MGU into ASGI, which belong to other acquirers and are not recorded here. Later DEFA14A and DEF 14A excerpts (2022-10 to 2024) show only headers and no outcome.
